b: Weekend Wisdom: You don’t have to wait for things to be good to be grateful.

It’s that time of year when we have to be even more intentional about how we want to feel. It’s so easy to get swept up in the hustle bustle (and it’s ok if you do). Even though the last bit of the year presents endless opportunities to over-do it (in the name of holiday joy), it also invites you to keep coming back to you. Check in on your energy, your patience and your sleep. A daily check in with heart is usually enough for any shifts or necessary resets.

There’s an endless amount of data you can connect to with rings and watches and other devices. You can see on a screen when you are run down, inactive or not sleeping well. You know what other device will share that information in real time? Your heart. Keep checking in, listen and trust the data of you.

Now I have time for the good stuff like peace, ease, creativity, laughter and love. Let's simplify together, not so we can have a simple life, but so we can have the life we really want.
